summary: Iteration 34 (BOTH platforms, backend+frontend) — EDIT + DELETE for posts, reels and videos on web AND mobile, plus custom thumbnail picker on WEB video upload. All checks pass. BACKEND (pytest, 11/11): PUT /api/posts/{id} — owner edits caption+game_tag for both post AND reel and persists on GET; non-owner -> 403; unauth -> 401/403; unknown id -> 404. PUT /api/videos/{id} — owner full edit (title/description/thumbnail_url/visibility/category/tags) persists on GET; non-owner -> 403. DELETE /api/posts/{id} owner -> 200 + subsequent GET 404; reel delete by non-owner -> 403. DELETE /api/videos/{id} owner -> 200; 2nd DELETE -> 404. WEB (founder auth via localStorage 'postmeplex.token'): Home feed on OWN post/reel/video shows Edit pencil + Delete trash (post-edit-<id>/post-delete-<id>, feed-reel-edit-<id>/feed-reel-delete-<id>, feed-video-edit-<id>/feed-video-delete-<id>). Edit opens EditContentModal (edit-content-modal); saving via edit-save-btn calls PUT and persists (verified via API GET after save): post caption+game_tag saved as 'TEST_iter34_UI post edited via modal'/'Overwatch'; video full edit saved title='TEST_iter34_UI video EDITED title', visibility='unlisted', category='IRL', tags=['one','two','three']. Detail routes: PostDetail (/posts/:id) post-detail-edit + post-detail-delete work + edit persists ('TEST_iter34_UI post detail EDITED'). ReelWatch (/reels/:id) reel-edit-btn + reel-delete-btn work + edit persists. VideoWatch (/videos/:id) video-edit-btn + video-delete-btn work + edit persists. Ownership guard: after switching to a fresh bystander token, PostDetail/ReelWatch/VideoWatch show 0 edit + 0 delete controls and the home feed shows 0 owner controls for the founder-owned items. VideoUpload (/videos/new): new custom picker video-thumb-upload-btn renders with hidden accept='image/*' file input and preview slot present. MOBILE (Expo web preview, PIN 7455): Home feed OWN items show post-more-<id> (PostCard) + owner-menu-<id> (ReelFeedCard, VideoFeedCard). Tapping opens the menu with post-menu-edit-<id>/post-menu-delete-<id> or owner-edit-<id>/owner-delete-<id>. Selecting edit opens EditContentSheet with edit-post-caption or edit-video-title/description etc; saving via edit-save-btn persists (verified via API GET): post -> 'TEST_iter34_M post edited mobile', reel -> 'TEST_iter34_M reel edited mobile', video -> 'TEST_iter34_M video edited mobile'. Video watch /video/<id>: watch-edit + watch-delete pills present. Reels player /(tabs)/reels?startId=<id>: owner-menu-<id> present on right rail. Mobile video upload /video/upload: upload-pick-thumb still present.

issues: React warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — a11y improvement: add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) inside DialogContent.

action_items: (optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to EditContentModal to silence Radix a11y warning.

(follow-up from iter32) Delete-policy asymmetry still stands: videos allow super-admin override (routes/videos.py:203) but posts do not (server.py:1348). Same asymmetry now applies to EDIT — PUT /api/posts/{id} rejects even super-admins. Pick one policy.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:1342 PUT /api/posts/{id} has no super-admin bypass while /app/backend/routes/videos.py:185-186 also lacks it (edit is owner-only for videos too, unlike DELETE at line 203 which DOES bypass for super-admin). Result: super-admins can delete any video but cannot edit any post/reel/video. Either add the bypass to all mutating endpoints or drop it from DELETE videos.

/app/backend/server.py:1350-1358 update_post silently ignores media_url and comment counts, which is correct per spec, but it also does NOT enforce that a reel keeps a non-empty video_url — since editors cannot change video_url this is moot today, but if that Pydantic body ever grows a video_url field the current 'update whatever is not None' pattern will let owners break a reel by nulling its media.

/app/frontend/src/components/EditContentModal.jsx uses onOpenChange={(v) => !v && onClose?.()} and does NOT reset local state when the modal closes without saving. If the owner opens Edit on Post A, cancels, and opens Edit on Post B before the useEffect has run, state briefly retains A's caption. Not user-visible in practice but a stale-state hazard — call onClose then reset via a key or an explicit reset.
/app/frontend/src/pages/VideoUpload.jsx:36-53 onThumb has no MAX file size or MIME-type guard — a 100 MB PNG will be uploaded silently. Add a check similar to MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES / accept validation.

/app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx and mobile equivalents both use window.confirm() / Alert.alert for destructive delete. Consistent but neither confirms which item is being deleted (caption/title). Consider showing the item title in the confirm text.
/app/mobile/src/components/OwnerContentMenu.tsx re-implements a lightweight popover inline; consider extracting into a shared component (same menu pattern is also in PostCard.tsx) to keep parity.
